question_cn: I 组头名（小组第一出线）是哪支球队？
question_en: Which team finishes first in Group I?
one_liner_cn: 法国阵容齐整且 Elo 高出挪威约 150 分，约 72% 概率拿下 I 组头名；挪威有哈兰德但厄德高伤情存疑，塞内加尔是第三选项。
one_liner_en: A full-strength France, ~150 Elo points above Norway, win Group I in about 72% of simulations; Norway have an in-form Haaland but Odegaard's fitness is in doubt, with Senegal a distant third option.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 断层：法国 2063（世界第 3）对挪威 1914（第 11）、塞内加尔 1860（第 21）、伊拉克 1607（第 63），10 万次纯 Elo 模拟给出法国 70.4% 的头名基线。
key_reasons.en: Elo gap: France 2063 (world No. 3) vs Norway 1914 (No. 11), Senegal 1860 (No. 21), Iraq 1607 (No. 63); the 100k pure-Elo simulation gives France a 70.4% group-winner baseline.

key_reasons.cn: 法国满员出战：姆巴佩伤愈入选并出任队长，德尚明确排除萨利巴伤情疑虑，无停赛或伤病危机。
key_reasons.en: France at full strength: Mbappe recovered and named captain, Deschamps dismissed Saliba fitness fears; no suspension or injury crisis.

key_reasons.cn: 挪威核心隐患：哈兰德确认出战且状态火热（预选赛 16 球），但厄德高本季至少 5 次伤停、缺席 3 月友谊赛，组织端高度依赖其健康——挪威基线下调 2pp。
key_reasons.en: Norway's core risk: Haaland is confirmed fit and in form (16 qualifying goals), but Odegaard suffered at least five injuries this season and missed the March friendlies; creativity hinges on his health — Norway adjusted down 2pp.

method_note: Baseline: 100,000 full-tournament pure-Elo Poisson Monte Carlo simulations (seed 20260611, eloratings.net snapshot 2026-06-11, no market input). Bounded evidence adjustment: Norway -2pp for Odegaard fitness uncertainty (cited), redistributed proportionally to the other teams and renormalized to sum 1; all per-team deltas within +/-4pp.
